statements.query: select "id", "name", "email", "created_at" as "createdAt", (select coalesce(json_agg(agg), '[]') from (select "p"."id", "p"."title", "p"."body", "p"."created_at" as "createdAt", (select coalesce(json_agg(agg), '[]') from (select "c"."id", "c"."author", "c"."body", "c"."created_at" as "createdAt" from "comments" as "c" where "c"."post_id" = "p"."id" order by "c"."id") as agg) as "comments" from "posts" as "p" where "p"."user_id" = "users"."id" order by "p"."id") as agg) as "posts" from "users" where "users"."id" = $1
